data.street_address: 22 Hertsmere Road,  Canary Wharf,  London,  E14 4ED

description.text:
Great steaks... and that''s no bull! Set in a modern steakhouse ambience overlooking the Canary Wharf quay side, Manhattan Grill offers the ultimate steak for those meat lovers out there.

Our USDA beef comes from the great American plains and is grain-fed for 150 days for unique marbling, subtle texture and unsurpassed flavour. We also offer a wide variety of fine wines from South Africa, Chile, Argentina and France which can be bought by the bottle or by the glass, thanks to a high-tech wine preserving system.

Our G&Tea Lounge is a great place to meet with friends and colleagues for pre-dinner drinks. With a relaxed mood by day and a vibrant air by night, it is the ideal place for unwinding and recharging, or for an informal gathering after hours. Sample a few gins from our extensive collection of over 180 types, or join us for that quintessentially-British afternoon tea experience. The freshly-baked scones, delicious sandwiches and decadent pastries are to die for, and the Champagne toast is a must.
